overview.short: Bodh Gaya in Bihar is the spiritual center of Buddhism worldwide, where Gautama Buddha attained supreme enlightenment beneath the sacred Bodhi Tree.
overview.description: Revered as the holiest Buddhist pilgrimage site on Earth, Bodh Gaya surrounds the majestic 55-metre stone spire of the Mahabodhi Temple Complex (UNESCO World Heritage). Here beneath the sprawling branches of the sacred Bodhi Tree and upon the polished granite Vajrasana (Diamond Throne), Siddhartha Gautama sat in deep meditation and achieved supreme spiritual awakening in 528 BCE. The town features magnificent international monasteries built by Japan, Thailand, Bhutan, Tibet, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar, alongside the towering 80-foot Great Buddha Statue.

howToReach.roadNote: Connected via Grand Trunk Road (NH19 / NH22) with direct 4-lane highways connecting Patna (110 km), Varanasi (250 km), and Kolkata (480 km).

topPlaces.name: Mahabodhi Temple Complex (UNESCO)
topPlaces.description: Magnificent 55-metre 5th-century sandstone pyramidal spire marking the exact spot of Gautama Buddha’s enlightenment.

image.alt: Mahabodhi Temple Complex (UNESCO) in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Sacred Bodhi Tree & Vajrasana
topPlaces.description: Direct descendant of the ancient Peepal tree beneath which Siddhartha Gautama sat upon the polished granite Diamond Throne.

image.alt: Sacred Bodhi Tree & Vajrasana in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Great Buddha Statue (80-foot)
topPlaces.description: Colossal 80-foot meditative red granite and sandstone Buddha statue consecrated by the 14th Dalai Lama in 1989.

image.alt: Great Buddha Statue (80-foot) in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Royal Bhutan Monastery & Thai Temple
topPlaces.description: Exquisitely carved Buddhist monasteries featuring traditional Bhutanese clay frescoes, gilded spires, and peaceful landscaped courtyards.

image.alt: Royal Bhutan Monastery & Thai Temple in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Dungeshwari Cave Temples (Mahakala)
topPlaces.description: Pre-enlightenment cliffside caves where Buddha practiced intense ascetic penance for six years before descending to the Bodhi Tree.

image.alt: Dungeshwari Cave Temples (Mahakala) in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Muchalinda Lake & Lotus Sanctuary
topPlaces.description: Sacred temple pond shaded by verdant green foliage, commemorating where the Serpent King sheltered Buddha during a great tempest.

image.alt: Muchalinda Lake & Lotus Sanctuary in Bodh Gaya, Bihar

itinerary.title: Supreme Enlightenment Sanctuary & Global Monasteries
itinerary.description: Experience the profound tranquility of Mahabodhi Temple, the sacred Bodhi Tree, and ornate international Buddhist monasteries.

itinerary.title: Colossal Statues, Sacred Caves & Peaceful Waters
itinerary.description: Contemplate the 80-foot Great Buddha, meditate in the ancient Dungeshwari cliffside caves, and visit Muchalinda Lake.
